long_biography.plain_text:
Smith grew up in Salisbury, North Carolina, where his father helped found the grocery chain that became Food Lion. After graduating from North Carolina State University in 1971, he worked as an engineer before moving into property. He and Julian "Bubba" Rawl formed a partnership that became Preston Development Company, building planned communities around Cary and the Triangle.

A financially backed purchase of the 1,400-acre Preston development gave the company its name and an early platform for expansion. Over more than four decades, the partners moved into residential, commercial and coastal projects across North Carolina. Their largest undertaking is Chatham Park, an 8,500-acre mixed-use community near Pittsboro planned for tens of thousands of residents, where Smith's engineering background informs long-term land and infrastructure decisions.
